name: Jump-and-run
coreLoop: Run, jump over gaps and enemies, grab the goodies, and reach the end of the level.
defaultFeatures: Run and jump with tight, fair controls
A few short levels that get harder
Coins or stars to collect
Simple enemies to dodge or stomp
extraFeatures: Checkpoints so you don't restart the whole level
A level editor so players can build their own levels

name: Kart racer
coreLoop: Race around a track, grab power-ups, and try to finish first.
defaultFeatures: Drive, drift and boost
A few tracks
Power-ups you pick up on the track
Computer players to race against
extraFeatures: Split-screen for 2 players on one screen
Time trial with your best lap saved

name: Farming & cozy life
coreLoop: Plant crops, wait for them to grow, sell them, and spend the money to make your farm better.
defaultFeatures: Plant, water and harvest crops
Days that end at bedtime, and seasons that change
A shop to sell crops and buy seeds
Save your farm and keep playing tomorrow
extraFeatures: Townspeople you can make friends with
Play the same farm with a friend online

name: Survive the swarm
coreLoop: Walk around while your weapons fire on their own, survive waves of monsters, and pick a new power each time you level up.
defaultFeatures: Move with keys or a thumb stick; weapons attack by themselves
Waves of monsters that grow bigger
Pick 1 of 3 upgrades when you level up
A run lasts about 10 minutes
extraFeatures: Weapons that combine into stronger ones

name: Card battler
coreLoop: Play cards from your hand to beat an enemy, then add new cards to your deck and fight the next one.
defaultFeatures: Draw a hand of cards and spend energy to play them
Enemies that show what they will do next
Add a new card after each win
A map with paths to choose
extraFeatures: A shop to remove or buy cards
Different heroes with their own cards
Daily challenge with the same seed for everyone

name: Puzzle game
coreLoop: Move and turn pieces or tiles to make matches or fill lines, before the board fills up.
defaultFeatures: Pieces that drop, move and turn
Clear lines or matches for points
It speeds up as you play
High score saved on your device

name: Action shooter
coreLoop: Move fast, aim, and blast enemies before they get you, then find the exit.
defaultFeatures: Move and shoot with keys and mouse (or thumb sticks)
Rooms or waves of enemies
Health and ammo pickups
Short levels with an exit

name: Tower defense
coreLoop: Build towers along a path so the monsters walking down it never reach your base.
defaultFeatures: Monsters walk a path in waves
Place and upgrade towers with coins
Lose lives when monsters get through
A few maps
extraFeatures: Towers with special powers (slow, splash, poison)
Monsters that find their own path around your towers

name: Adventure RPG
coreLoop: Explore, talk to people, fight monsters, get stronger, and finish quests.
defaultFeatures: Walk around a world made of a few areas
Talk to characters and get quests
Fight monsters and level up
Save your game

name: Build & manage
coreLoop: Build things on a map, keep everything running and everyone happy, and earn money to build bigger.
defaultFeatures: Place buildings, roads or rides on a grid
Money that goes up and down
Little people who walk around and have needs
Save and load your city or park
extraFeatures: Huge maps with thousands of people

name: Strategy game
coreLoop: Gather resources, build a base or empire, train an army, and outsmart the other side.
defaultFeatures: Gather resources like food, wood and gold
Build buildings and train units
Computer players to beat
A map you explore
extraFeatures: Tech tree to unlock new things

name: Party & friends game
coreLoop: Play quick rounds with friends, guess, vote or race, and laugh about it.
defaultFeatures: Quick rounds of 2 to 5 minutes
Friends join on their phones with a room code
Score board between rounds
Works with 3 to 10 players

name: Block-building sandbox
coreLoop: Explore a world made of blocks, dig them up, and build anything you can imagine.
defaultFeatures: A 3D world made of blocks
Dig blocks and place them
Day and night
Save your world

name: Text adventure
coreLoop: Read where you are, type what you want to do, and solve puzzles to explore further.
defaultFeatures: Type what you want to do, like "go north"
Rooms to explore with puzzles
Items to pick up and use
Save your game
